content.title: About
content.content: PowerBar is a protein‑rich nutrition bar designed for athletes and active people. It provides fast‑digesting carbohydrates, protein, and a blend of vitamins to supply energy and support muscle recovery during and after workouts.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: PowerBar was first launched in the early 1990s and quickly became a favorite among marathon runners.
The bars are available in a variety of flavors, including chocolate, nut, and fruit.
The formula often includes whey protein isolate, which is rapidly absorbed by the body.
Some PowerBar versions are fortified with creatine and BCAA for extra recovery benefits.
Bars are non‑crumbling and stay stable at moderate temperatures, making them easy to carry.

items.title: Quick energy replenishment
items.content: A mix of simple and complex carbs delivers an immediate glucose boost and sustains blood‑sugar levels during prolonged activity.

items.title: Supports muscle recovery
items.content: Whey protein helps repair muscle fibers after intense training sessions.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2, B6, and B12 aid energy metabolism and support the nervous system.

items.title: Electrolyte content
items.content: Sodium and potassium help maintain fluid balance during sweating.

items.title: Convenient and portable
items.content: The bar is easy to store and transport, providing a practical nutrition source on the go.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Whey protein may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with dairy sensitivities.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Some PowerBar flavors contain significant amounts of sugar, which may be unsuitable for diabetics or those limiting sugar intake.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Bars are relatively calorie‑dense; they should be consumed in moderation, especially when managing weight.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Certain varieties use sucralose or aspartame, which some people prefer to avoid.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Consume PowerBar 30‑60 minutes before exercise for energy or immediately after training for recovery. It can be paired with water, a sports drink, or blended into a protein shake.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the bars in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal the package tightly to prevent moisture absorption.
